certificate.fallback_proof: Fixed no-OTP code: gross positive-syndrome sum >= k - n H(Bell) + H(HX). Renyi2 and Parseval give H(HX)>=n-k-log2(sum_dual delta^(2wt)). D(delta)>=delta^2/(2 ln2), log2(1+x)<=x/ln2, so same-code rate >= positive(delta^2/(2ln2)-H(Z|X)-sum_nonzero_dual delta^(2wt)/(n ln2)). Exact dual Hamming enumerator for simplex7: 1+7x^3+7x^4+x^7; SPC dual enumerator 1+x^n. No fallback upper is used.
